baseline_models.focus_anchor: The delayed nominative al-nudhur is the arriving subject of ja'a, while al Fir'awn is the collective reached.
baseline_models.mechanism: Coming makes warning an event that obtains in the addressee's world; the fear-bearing warning branch gives that event a caution-awakening function.

activation_trace.role: Coming and obtaining make the warning itself the event entering the household's world.
The household and retinue who return to a man supply the leader-centered collective that the event reaches.
Fear-bearing notice that awakens caution supplies the arriving event's preventive purpose.

changed_reading.before: Warnings were delivered to Pharaoh's people.
changed_reading.after: Warning itself arrives and becomes present to Pharaoh's people as an event meant to awaken caution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al Fir'awn names its audience through relation and adjacency to Pharaoh rather than as an undifferentiated crowd.
baseline_models.mechanism: The household-return branch identifies a center and dependents, while the split-root proximity and succession branches expose an unbroken alignment network. The warning therefore penetrates a social structure organized around a leader.

activation_trace.role: A man's household, followers, and those whose relation returns to him supply the network's organizing center.
Nearness without an interval turns the named household into contiguous social alignment.
Succession without interruption supplies the chain through which leader-centered belonging extends.
The caution-awakening warning targets this connected alignment rather than an abstract population.

changed_reading.before: Al Fir'awn is merely a conventional label for Pharaoh's people.
changed_reading.after: Al Fir'awn is a leader-centered chain of proximity and following into which the warnings enter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier people do not fail to receive al-nudhur; they collectively classify it as false. This revises arrival from neutral delivery into accountable confrontation: reach and acceptance are different stages.

activation_trace.role: Coming and obtaining establish that the warning reaches its collective endpoint.
A notice meant to awaken caution defines what the collective must receive or resist.
Attributing a thing or its bearer to falsehood supplies the reception response and turns arrival into confrontation.
A human collective makes denial a social act, matching the focus's collective addressee.
The repeated caution-awakening warning links the earlier collective denial directly to the focus noun.

structural_cues: 54:33 pairs a named people with denial of al-nudhur; 54:41 repeats al-nudhur with a leader-centered al.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collective denial and the repeated warning noun; I supply the arrow that arrival establishes accountable exposure rather than assent. A live alternative is that 54:33 only closes the Lot unit without defining the focus arrival.

changed_reading.after: It reaches enough to be collectively confronted and denied; arrival marks exposure, not acceptance.

context_deltas.mechanism: A destructive agent is dispatched against a people, yet al Lut is excepted and saved by separation. Repetition of the al construction makes household affiliation a fate-bearing boundary, so al Fir'awn is more than an audience label when warning arrives.

activation_trace.role: The household and followers related back to Pharaoh supply the focus's corporate boundary.
Dispatch and setting-forth supply an incoming agent against which the household boundary matters.
The stone-bearing wind gives the dispatched event a materially destructive trajectory.
Al Lut supplies the matching household construction whose members form an excepted unit.
Deliverance by separation makes sorting within or from the exposed collective the operative result.

structural_cues: 54:34 places an exception before al Lut and then predicates rescue of them, making the household construction operational within the incoming event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, exception, household, and rescue-by-separation; I transfer that household-sorting mechanism to the repeated al construction in 54:41. A live alternative is that al functions only as a proper collective name in each episode.

changed_reading.before: Al Fir'awn simply identifies who heard the warnings.
changed_reading.after: It marks a relational unit exposed to an arriving event, with affiliation and separation now salient to how fate is distributed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from warning, through disputation, to overpowering grasp, tasted punishment, and settled consequence. The focus's arrival can therefore denote a warning process crossing from notice into embodied and enduring verification.

activation_trace.role: Coming and obtaining let the warning arrive through successive modes rather than as speech alone.
The fear-bearing notice opens the sequence as an opportunity for awakened caution.
Warning appears both as an act and as the plural notice, joining admonition to what follows.
Taking with force supplies the threatened consequence toward which warning points.
Denial of truth through disputation supplies the blocked response between notice and consequence.
Experiencing and undergoing a thing turns the warning's content into embodied verification.
Pain and punishment identify what is experienced when caution fails.
Fixity and settlement extend the consequence from a passing blow into an established condition.

structural_cues: 54:36 shares the focus's wa-laqad cadence and contains both the warning verb and plural noun; 54:37 and 54:39 repeat tasting punishment with warnings; 54:38 calls the punishment settled.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered states warning, dispute, force, taste, punishment, and settlement; I supply the directional arrow that these are phases of warning becoming actual. A live alternative keeps warning and punishment categorically separate despite their repeated coordination.

changed_reading.before: Warnings arrive as prior verbal notices.
changed_reading.after: Warnings arrive as an escalating process whose resisted notice becomes tasted and settled experience.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ease, recitation, and recovered remembrance immediately precede the focus. They recast the plural warnings as gathered narrative prompts that can arrive again whenever recitation activates caution in a later hearer.

activation_trace.role: The warning that awakens caution supplies the content made newly present to later hearers.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies accessibility for repeated warning reception.
Reading and recitation supply the repeatable medium through which a past warning arrives anew.
Bringing something back to mind after forgetfulness makes historical warning an active present recollection.

structural_cues: The refrain about ease for remembrance stands immediately before the focus's compact historical notice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ease, recitation, remembrance, and the adjacent warning report; I supply the arrow that recitation re-delivers the warning to the current hearer. A live alternative treats 54:40 only as closure of the preceding episode.

changed_reading.before: Warnings came once to Pharaoh's household in the past.
changed_reading.after: Their arrival is replayable: gathered recitation makes the historical warning present again as an invitation to remember.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah specifies denial of all signs and answers it with seizure. This resolves the focus plural as cumulative evidentiary exposure: warnings arrive in a complete series, and total rejection converts the record of caution into grounds for accountability.

activation_trace.role: Plural caution-awakening notices supply the open set whose extent the next ayah sharpens.
Attributing the signs to falsehood supplies the household's comprehensive rejection response.
Visible signs give the plural warnings concrete evidentiary instances.
Total enclosure and completeness close off the possibility that only one warning channel was refused.
Being taken to account for fault supplies the consequence of completed evidentiary rejection.

structural_cues: 54:42 immediately resumes the plural household with they, marks all signs as denied, and uses fa before the doubled taking construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate anaphoric continuity, all signs, denial, and consequential taking; I infer that the signs instantiate or explain the focus warnings. A live alternative allows substantial overlap without making signs and warnings coextensive.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified plurality of warnings came to Pharaoh's household.
changed_reading.after: A cumulative and complete sign-record reached them; denying the whole record made warning evidentiary grounds for seizure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later audience is compared with prior rejecters and challenged to produce an exemption in written records. The Pharaoh-centered household therefore becomes a precedent: its received warnings remove any later collective's claim to inherited superiority or textual discharge.

activation_trace.role: The leader-centered household supplies the historical collective whose case can be compared with a later one.
Received caution supplies the notice that makes the historical case relevant to accountability.
Veiling truth identifies the later collective by the same failed relation to evidence.
Comparative excellence supplies the challenged claim that the later group might outrank prior cases.
Separation and exemption supply the imagined release from the precedent's reach.
Writing and books supply the record in which any claimed exemption would need standing.

structural_cues: The interrogative comparison moves directly from Pharaoh's household to your rejecters and then asks for a written exemption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comparison, claimed superiority, exemption, and writings; I supply the legal arrow that the just-told household case functions as precedent and notice. A live alternative takes those as all prior communities collectively, not Pharaoh's household alone.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a closed report about one ancient household.
changed_reading.after: It enters a transferable record that confronts later collectives with precedent and denies ungrounded exemption.

context_deltas.mechanism: A coalition voices confidence in being gathered and self-defending; the next ayah breaks its formation and turns it backward. This activates al Fir'awn as a cohesion structure: warnings address the leader-centered alignment whose solidarity can reverse into retreat.

activation_trace.role: Household and followers who return to a leader supply the retinue whose cohesion is tested.
Uninterrupted succession supplies the alignment chain that collective defeat will interrupt.
Voiced assertion makes collective confidence an explicit self-description rather than an inferred attitude.
Joining dispersed parts into one whole supplies the coalition's claimed cohesion.
Mutual aid and making victory manifest supply the coalition's expected protection.
Breaking and driving back a battle line reverses the asserted integrity of the gathered whole.
The same gathered whole becomes the explicit object of defeat.
Turning away and withdrawing converts proximity and following into abandonment.
Presenting the back and turning away gives the social reversal a bodily direction.

structural_cues: 54:44's first-person claim of gathered strength is followed by 54:45's passive defeat and plural backward turn.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a gathered coalition, expected mutual defense, broken ranks, and retreat; I project that social mechanics back onto the focus's al. A live alternative keeps the later coalition distinct while using Pharaoh's household only as one item in a broader analogy.

changed_reading.before: Al Fir'awn is a stable dynastic name receiving warnings.
changed_reading.after: It is a leader-centered alignment whose apparent continuity and mutual protection are precisely what warning exposes as reversible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the return-to-outcome branch behind the surface household sense of al. It remains anchored to focus word 3 and is tightened by the immediate total denial and taking; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary outcome resonance, never as the direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The mapped ء و ل inventory lets al Fir'awn echo both Pharaoh's household and what that household returns or comes to.

activation_trace.role: Return to an end or outcome supplies a prospective resonance inside the household expression.
Coming and obtaining let that outcome resonance become present with the warning.
Completeness makes the disclosed evidentiary course total rather than partial.
Taking to account supplies the outcome that the warning already makes visible.

changed_reading.before: The warning predicts a later outcome for Pharaoh's household.
changed_reading.after: In a contained root resonance, the household's ma'al arrives already in warning form before the taking realizes it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a branch-distant spatial analogy built from the pooled-water-around-a-fort image of ج ي ء, not the surface verb's direct sense. The focus verb and household keep it anchored, while local gravel and totality make accumulation coherent; downstream prose should qualify it as an image of pressure or saturation, not lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Ja'a at focus word 2 has a collateral branch image of matter gathering in a depression or around a fort, while al supplies the social enclosure.

activation_trace.role: A pool collecting in a depression or around a fort supplies accumulation and encirclement instead of one-time transit.
The Pharaoh-centered household supplies the bounded social enclosure around which pressure gathers.
Gravel supplies the local particulate material that thickens the accumulation image.
Complete enclosure turns repeated pressure into total exposure of the household.

changed_reading.before: Warnings cross a boundary and arrive at the household.
changed_reading.after: Warnings can be pictured as accumulating around the Pharaoh-centered enclosure until total exposure replaces defensible distance.

strongest_changes: Arrival became accountable confrontation: warning reaches a collective even when that collective answers with denial.
The warn-dispute-taste-settle sequence turned al-nudhur from speech alone into an event that actualizes as experience.
The adjacent remembrance refrain and complete sign-record made the plural warnings both replayable for later hearers and cumulative evidence against total rejection.
summary.what_was_special: The focus grammar makes warning the arriving subject, while the split al inventories expose both a leader-centered alignment and an outcome resonance. The later gathered-strength and defeat sequence makes collective cohesion part of what warning tests.
remaining_uncertainties: Al Fir'awn may emphasize family, adherents, administrative retinue, or the whole leader-centered polity in different proportions.
All signs in 54:42 may instantiate the warnings or only overlap with them as a broader evidentiary category.
The outcome and accumulation readings are deliberately branch-distant and may be too marked for unqualified downstream prose.
